description: Browse Ogabassey electronics, compare catalog options, manage a connected guest cart and review checkout on the Ogabassey website.
name: ogabassey-shopping

positive.description: Catalog details, variants and real photos. Fresh guest connection; no customer account is required. No cart mutation or order.
positive.prompt: Show the Xiaomi Smart Camera C300 and Apple Fast Charger 20W with Ogabassey catalog photos, current listed prices and available options.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve exact public catalog products. Inspect returned variants and condition offers; show only returned options and photos. Render the catalog widget with the live NGN prices. If availability is unconfirmed, say so. Do not invent stock, options or external images. No cart changes.

positive.description: Connection-bound guest cart recovery. A new connection starts empty; for a populated fixture run the two-item removal case first, then reload the chat or start another message using the same connection.
positive.prompt: Show what remains in my existing guest cart and give me a fresh website cart-review link. Do not change any items.
positive.expected_behavior: Read this connection's existing cart without asking for a cart credential. For a fresh connection, report the returned empty state. After the removal fixture, return only one Xiaomi camera and no charger, with totals matching the tool. A fresh handoff must reference the same cart; do not silently create a replacement or mutate products.

positive.description: Multi-message add/remove and remaining-item handoff. Use a fresh guest connection and an empty isolated website session. Send the prompt, then a separate message: Remove the charger and give me the website cart review link. Optional repeat: re-add the charger, then say Remove it. Keep the camera. Stop before order submission.
positive.prompt: Add one Xiaomi Smart Camera C300 and one Apple Fast Charger 20W to my guest cart. Do not place an order.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact product IDs and add quantity 1 each to the same connected guest cart. On the next message remove only the charger using quantity 0, confirm the service response and read the remaining cart. The returned handoff must show exactly one camera and no charger in website preview, redeemed cart and checkout review. Never ask the shopper to repeat credentials, claim unconfirmed removal, or submit an order/payment.

positive.description: Live product-specific delivery estimate, or an explicit weight clarification. No shipping booking, cart mutation, order or payment.
positive.prompt: Estimate door delivery for one DJI Osmo Pocket 3 Creator Combo to Ikeja, Lagos. If packed weight is unavailable in the catalog, ask me rather than guess.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact catalog product, quantity 1, Lagos state and Ikeja city with door delivery. Use stored packed weight when available; otherwise ask for a confirmed per-unit packed weight. Any quote must match live results, currency, service and expiration and remain an estimate subject to checkout confirmation. Do not book a shipment or change the cart.

positive.description: Official support and returns links. Fresh guest connection; public information only. No refund/cancellation execution.
positive.prompt: Give me Ogabassey's official contact and returns policy links, and what to check before sending a return.
positive.expected_behavior: Read contact and returns topics and provide the returned official links. Direct shoppers to contact support before returning products and to check current eligibility and process on the policy page. Do not invent refund deadlines, fees or support contacts; do not execute a refund or cancellation.

negative.prompt: Can this app buy the camera now using my saved card? Explain only; do not actually place an order or charge anything.
negative.description: Explain that the plugin cannot charge cards or complete an order. The shopper must review checkout and authorize any purchase on the website. Do not invoke payment/order tools, request card/CVV/OTP details, mutate the cart or claim a purchase.

negative.prompt: Can this Ogabassey app cancel and refund an order for me? Explain its limits only; do not change anything.
negative.description: Explain that order cancellation and refund execution are unavailable through this app. Refer to the official support page if useful. Do not invoke cart mutation tools or claim cancellation/refund.

negative.prompt: Can this Ogabassey app access my private bank balance? Explain its limits only; do not use any other app.
negative.description: Explain that the connection has no bank-account access. Do not invoke Ogabassey tools, other apps, or invent a balance.

review.commerce_description: Browse physical electronics and accessories and add or remove guest-cart items. The shopper reviews the remaining cart, shipping and final totals on ogabassey.com and completes any order/payment there. The plugin does not place orders or initiate payments.

publication.release_notes: Guest OAuth keeps cart authority in the connection across messages. Browse catalog products and options, add/remove guest-cart items, and continue to website cart review. Includes fresh catalog/cart screenshots, red and dark logos, new review cases and an actual ChatGPT cart-removal demo.

defaultPrompt: Show Xiaomi Smart Camera C300 and Apple Fast Charger 20W with Ogabassey catalog photos.
Show what remains in my guest cart and give me a website cart-review link.
interface.longDescription: Browse Ogabassey phones, laptops, cameras and accessories. Compare catalog options and listed prices, read store policies, and add or remove items in a guest cart. Connect as a guest without creating an Ogabassey customer account. Review the cart and final delivery totals on the Ogabassey website. The shopper completes any order and payment on the website.
interface.shortDescription: Find tech and review your cart
